question: Consider the following statements regarding 'World Ozone Day': I. It is observed annually on September 16. II. It marks the signing of the Montreal Protocol. III. The protocol it commemorates was signed in 1987. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Ozone Day is universally observed on September 16. Statement I is true. Step 2: The day specifically commemorates the historic signing of the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer. Statement II is true. Step 3: This landmark environmental treaty was officially signed on this date in the baseline year of 1987. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Do not confuse the Montreal Protocol (1987, ozone) with the Kyoto Protocol (1997, greenhouse gases). September 16 is strictly tied to Montreal.
tip: September 16 marks the 1987 signing of the Montreal Protocol for ozone protection.

question: Match the following International Days with their historical baseline treaties: List I: A. World Wetlands Day B. World Wildlife Day C. International Day for Biological Diversity. List II: 1. Adoption of CITES (1973) 2. Adoption of the CBD text (1992) 3. Adoption of the Ramsar Convention (1971). Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World Wetlands Day (February 2) commemorates the 1971 adoption of the Ramsar Convention in Iran (A-3). Step 2: World Wildlife Day (March 3) marks the 1973 adoption of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) (B-1). Step 3: Biological Diversity Day (May 22) marks the 1992 adoption of the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) text in Nairobi (C-2).
trick: Trap: All three deal with ecology, but they map to specific baseline years: Ramsar (1971), CITES (1973), and CBD (1992).
tip: Wetlands: Ramsar 1971. Wildlife: CITES 1973. Biodiversity: CBD 1992.

question: Regarding 'Human Rights Day', consider the following statements: I. It is observed annually on December 10. II. It commemorates the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR). III. The UDHR was adopted in 1945, coinciding with the founding of the UN. Which is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: Human Rights Day is observed on December 10 globally. Statement I is true. Step 2: It directly commemorates the adoption of the UDHR by the UN General Assembly. Statement II is true. Step 3: While the UN was founded in 1945, the UDHR was adopted three years later in the baseline year of 1948. Statement III is false.
trick: Trap: Assuming the UN Charter and the UDHR were adopted in the exact same year. The UN was formed in 1945, UDHR in 1948.
tip: Human Rights Day (Dec 10) marks the 1948 adoption of the UDHR.

question: The observance of 'World Population Day' on July 11 was historically triggered by which precise demographic milestone?
options: The founding of the UN Population Fund (UNFPA) in 1969.
The global population reaching Seven Billion in 2011.
The 'Five Billion Day' observed on July 11, 1987.
The adoption of the Millennium Development Goals in 2000.
answer: The 'Five Billion Day' observed on July 11, 1987.
explanation: Step 1: World Population Day was established by the UNDP Governing Council in 1989. Step 2: The date July 11 was explicitly chosen to commemorate 'Five Billion Day'. Step 3: This was the approximate date in the baseline year 1987 when the global human population reached five billion, generating massive public interest.
trick: Trap: Do not confuse the founding of UNFPA with the day's trigger. The 'Five Billion' milestone in 1987 is the official historical anchor.
tip: July 11 marks 'Five Billion Day' (1987), triggering World Population Day.

question: Match the following UN Specialized Agencies with the exact date their foundation is commemorated as an International Day: List I: A. World Health Organization (WHO) B. Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) C. Universal Postal Union (UPU). List II: 1. October 9 (1874) 2. April 7 (1948) 3. October 16 (1945). Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World Health Day is April 7, marking the founding of WHO in 1948 (A-2). Step 2: World Food Day is October 16, marking the founding of the FAO in Quebec City in 1945 (B-3). Step 3: World Post Day is October 9, marking the establishment of the UPU in 1874 via the Treaty of Bern (C-1).
trick: Trap: 'World Health Day' is observed on April 7 because it marks the exact founding anniversary of the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1948. Similarly, 'World Post Day' on October 9 marks the establishment of the Universal Postal Union (UPU) in 1874!
tip: WHO = April 7 (1948). FAO = October 16 (1945). UPU = October 9 (1874).

question: Consider the following regarding 'World Environment Day': I. It is universally observed on June 5. II. It commemorates the signing of the Paris Climate Agreement. III. It marks the opening day of the 1972 UN Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Environment Day is celebrated on June 5. Statement I is true. Step 2: It does not commemorate the Paris Agreement (which occurred in 2015). Statement II is false. Step 3: June 5 was chosen because it marks the opening of the landmark 1972 Stockholm Conference, which led to the creation of UNEP. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: The Paris Agreement is a common distractor for environmental questions. World Environment Day anchors to the foundational 1972 Stockholm Conference.
tip: June 5 marks the 1972 Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment.

question: Which major international convention's adoption is commemorated annually on 'International Civil Aviation Day' on December 7?
explanation: Step 1: International Civil Aviation Day is observed globally on December 7. Step 2: It was established in 1994 by the ICAO. Step 3: This date commemorates the 1944 signing of the Convention on International Civil Aviation, widely known as the 'Chicago Convention', which effectively created ICAO.
trick: Trap: Montreal, Warsaw, and Tokyo are all valid aviation treaties, but the foundational 1944 treaty establishing the ICAO is strictly the Chicago Convention.
tip: Civil Aviation Day (Dec 7) marks the 1944 signing of the Chicago Convention.

question: Regarding 'World Water Day', consider the following statements: I. It is observed on March 22. II. The concept was formally proposed during the 1992 UN Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED). III. It marks the signing of the UN Watercourses Convention. Which is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Water Day is observed on March 22. Statement I is true. Step 2: The idea was officially proposed at the 1992 Earth Summit (UNCED) in Rio de Janeiro. Statement II is true. Step 3: It does NOT commemorate the UN Watercourses Convention (which was adopted in 1997). Statement III is false.
trick: Trap: Linking the day to a specific water convention. It was actually born out of the broader 1992 Rio Earth Summit's Agenda 21.
tip: World Water Day (March 22) was proposed at the 1992 Rio Earth Summit (UNCED).

question: Match the following Technology and IP days with the conventions they mark: List I: A. World Intellectual Property Day B. World Telecommunication and Information Society Day C. World Meteorological Day. List II: 1. Founding of ITU in 1865 2. Entry into force of the WMO Convention in 1950 3. Entry into force of the WIPO Convention in 1970. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World IP Day (April 26) marks the 1970 entry into force of the WIPO Convention (A-3). Step 2: World Telecommunication Day (May 17) marks the founding of the International Telegraph Union (now ITU) in 1865 (B-1). Step 3: World Met Day (March 23) marks the 1950 entry into force of the WMO Convention (C-2).
trick: Trap: The ITU is incredibly old (1865). WIPO and WMO are post-WWII UN specialized agencies. IP Day is linked to the 1970 WIPO convention.
tip: IP Day: WIPO (1970). Telecom Day: ITU (1865). Met Day: WMO (1950).

question: The 'International Day of United Nations Peacekeepers' is observed on May 29. What is the precise historical milestone of this date?
options: The adoption of the UN Charter in 1945.
The awarding of the Nobel Peace Prize to UN Peacekeepers in 1988.
The deployment of the first UN peacekeeping mission (UNTSO) in Palestine in 1948.
The signing of the Geneva Conventions in 1949.
answer: The deployment of the first UN peacekeeping mission (UNTSO) in Palestine in 1948.
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: May 29. Step 2: This day was established by the UNGA in 2002 to honor UN Peacekeepers. Step 3: It specifically marks the anniversary of the creation of the first UN peacekeeping mission, the UN Truce Supervision Organization (UNTSO), in Palestine in 1948.
trick: Trap: The Nobel Prize was awarded to peacekeepers in 1988, but May 29 is strictly anchored to their very first operational deployment in 1948.
tip: Peacekeepers Day (May 29) marks the first UNTSO mission in Palestine in 1948.

question: Consider the following statements regarding 'World Refugee Day': I. It is observed on June 20. II. It commemorates the adoption of the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees. III. Before becoming a global UN day, it coincided with 'Africa Refugee Day'. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Refugee Day is universally observed on June 20. Statement I is true. Step 2: The UNGA established it in 2000 to mark the 50th anniversary of the 1951 Refugee Convention. Statement II is true. Step 3: June 20 was chosen to deliberately coincide with 'Africa Refugee Day', honoring Africa's generosity in hosting refugees. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Assuming it was always a standalone global day. The UN specifically aligned it with Africa Refugee Day to show solidarity.
tip: World Refugee Day (June 20) aligns with the 1951 Convention and Africa Refugee Day.

question: Match the following global health observances with the specific milestones they commemorate: List I: A. World AIDS Day B. World Tuberculosis Day C. World Blood Donor Day. List II: 1. Dr. Robert Koch's 1882 discovery of the TB bacillus 2. The 1988 summit of Health Ministers on programs for HIV/AIDS 3. The birth anniversary of Karl Landsteiner, who discovered the ABO blood group. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World AIDS Day (Dec 1) originated from the 1988 World Summit of Ministers of Health on Programmes for AIDS Prevention (A-2). Step 2: World TB Day (March 24) marks Robert Koch's 1882 discovery of the bacterium causing TB (B-1). Step 3: World Blood Donor Day (June 14) marks the birthday of Karl Landsteiner, who discovered blood groups (C-3).
trick: Trap: Blood Donor day specifically honors Karl Landsteiner, the scientist who made safe blood transfusions possible, linking biology to the observance.
tip: AIDS: 1988 Summit. TB: Koch's discovery (1882). Blood Donor: Landsteiner's birthday.

question: The 'World Press Freedom Day' observed on May 3 commemorates the adoption of which landmark declaration?
options: The Paris Declaration on Media Freedom (1995)
The Geneva Accord on Free Speech (1989)
The New York Charter on Journalism (1993)
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: May 3. Step 2: UNESCO established World Press Freedom Day. Step 3: The date marks the anniversary of the 1991 Declaration of Windhoek, a pioneering statement of free press principles put together by African journalists in Namibia.
trick: Trap: Freedom of the press feels like a Western/European treaty initiative, but the Windhoek Declaration was a pivotal African journalistic milestone.
tip: World Press Freedom Day (May 3) marks the 1991 Windhoek Declaration in Namibia.

question: Regarding the 'International Day to Combat Desertification and Drought', consider the following: I. It is observed on June 17. II. It commemorates the adoption of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD). III. The UNCCD was adopted in Paris in 1994. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: The day is observed annually on June 17. Statement I is true. Step 2: It specifically marks the adoption of the UNCCD framework. Statement II is true. Step 3: The UNCCD was officially adopted in Paris in the baseline year of 1994. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Distinguishing the three Rio Conventions. UNFCCC (Climate), CBD (Biodiversity), and UNCCD (Desertification). UNCCD adoption (June 17) is the trigger here.
tip: June 17 marks the 1994 adoption of the legally binding UNCCD framework.

question: Match the specific UN Days with their unique historical triggers: List I: A. Nelson Mandela International Day B. International Day of Non-Violence C. International Day of Charity. List II: 1. Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary 2. Mother Teresa's death anniversary 3. Nelson Mandela's birth anniversary. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: Nelson Mandela Day (July 18) marks his birth anniversary (A-3). Step 2: Int'l Day of Non-Violence (Oct 2) marks Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary (B-1). Step 3: Int'l Day of Charity (Sept 5) was chosen by the UNGA specifically to commemorate the passing away of Mother Teresa in 1997 (C-2).
trick: Trap: Charity Day isn't a random awareness date; it officially recognizes the work of Mother Teresa by anchoring to her death anniversary.
tip: Mandela: July 18. Non-Violence (Gandhi): Oct 2. Charity (Mother Teresa): Sept 5.

question: Consider 'World Tourism Day'. I. It is observed on September 27. II. It marks the anniversary of the adoption of the Statutes of the UNWTO in 1970. III. The UNWTO is headquartered in Paris. Which of the statements is/are INCORRECT?
explanation: Step 1: World Tourism Day is celebrated on September 27. Statement I is true. Step 2: The date marks the adoption of the UNWTO Statutes in 1970. Statement II is true. Step 3: The United Nations World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) is headquartered in Madrid, Spain, not Paris. Statement III is incorrect.
trick: Trap: The question asks for the INCORRECT statement. Assuming UN bodies are only in NY, Geneva, or Paris is a common distractor; UNWTO is in Madrid.
tip: World Tourism Day (Sept 27) marks UNWTO Statutes (1970). UNWTO is in Madrid.

question: Which international observance on April 18 was historically proposed by the International Council on Monuments and Sites (ICOMOS) and later approved by UNESCO in 1983?
options: World Heritage Day (International Day for Monuments and Sites)
answer: World Heritage Day (International Day for Monuments and Sites)
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date and the proposing body: April 18 and ICOMOS. Step 2: In 1982, ICOMOS proposed creating the International Day for Monuments and Sites. Step 3: UNESCO approved it during its 22nd General Conference in 1983. It is universally known as World Heritage Day.
trick: Trap: Museums belong to ICOM (May 18). Heritage/Monuments belong to ICOMOS (April 18).
tip: World Heritage Day (April 18) was proposed by ICOMOS and approved by UNESCO.

question: Regarding the 'International Day for the Eradication of Poverty' (October 17), consider the following: I. It commemorates a massive gathering at the Trocadéro in Paris in 1987. II. The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was signed at this exact location in 1948. III. It was officially recognized by the UN in 1992. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: On Oct 17, 1987, Father Joseph Wresinski led a rally against poverty at the Trocadéro plaza in Paris. Statement I is true. Step 2: The Trocadéro is historically significant as the site where the UDHR was signed in 1948. Statement II is true. Step 3: The UNGA formally declared October 17 as the eradication of poverty day in 1992. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Poverty day seems like a modern economic observance, but its roots are heavily tied to a specific 1987 human rights rally in Paris.
tip: Poverty Eradication Day (Oct 17) marks the 1987 Trocadéro rally in Paris.

question: Match the UN specific observances with their milestone triggers: List I: A. UN Day B. Human Space Flight Day C. International Day of Peace. List II: 1. Yuri Gagarin's 1961 spaceflight 2. The UN Charter entering into force in 1945 3. A dedicated resolution by the UNGA anchored on the ringing of the Peace Bell. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: UN Day (Oct 24) marks the anniversary of the entry into force of the UN Charter in 1945 (A-2). Step 2: International Day of Human Space Flight (April 12) marks the exact date of Yuri Gagarin's pioneering spaceflight in 1961 (B-1). Step 3: International Day of Peace (Sept 21) features the ringing of the Japanese Peace Bell at UN HQ (C-3).
trick: Trap: UN Day marks when the Charter *entered into force* (October), not when it was signed (June).
tip: UN Day (Oct 24) marks the 1945 entry into force of the UN Charter.

question: The 'World Soil Day' observed on December 5 was officially adopted by the 68th UN General Assembly in 2013. What is the historical trigger for choosing December 5?
options: It corresponds with the official birthday of King Bhumibol Adulyadej of Thailand.
It is the founding date of the International Union of Soil Sciences (IUSS).
It marks the day the UN 'Decade for Deserts' concluded.
It commemorates the signing of the Rio Earth Summit document on land degradation.
answer: It corresponds with the official birthday of King Bhumibol Adulyadej of Thailand.
explanation: Step 1: World Soil Day is held annually on December 5. Step 2: It was endorsed by the FAO and adopted by the UNGA. Step 3: The date was specifically chosen because it corresponds with the birthday of H.M. King Bhumibol Adulyadej of Thailand, who championed global soil conservation.
trick: Trap: International days often stem from treaties, but this one is uniquely tied to the birthday of a Thai monarch due to his role in soil advocacy.
tip: World Soil Day (Dec 5) honors the birthday of Thailand's King Bhumibol Adulyadej.

question: Consider 'World Radio Day'. I. It is observed on February 13. II. It commemorates the creation of United Nations Radio in 1946. III. The observance was originally proposed by the government of India. Which of the statements is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Radio Day is observed globally on February 13. Statement I is true. Step 2: The date marks the establishment of UN Radio in 1946. Statement II is true. Step 3: The day was proposed by the government of Spain to UNESCO, not India. Statement III is false.
trick: Trap: Many technology days mark patent dates, but Radio Day specifically honors the launch of the UN's own broadcasting arm in 1946.
tip: World Radio Day (Feb 13) marks the 1946 creation of United Nations Radio.

question: Which of the following days was established by the International Labour Organization (ILO) to commemorate the victims of occupational accidents and diseases, observed on April 28?
options: World Day for Safety and Health at Work
answer: World Day for Safety and Health at Work
explanation: Step 1: Identify the ILO observance on April 28. Step 2: May 1 is International Workers' Day (May Day). Step 3: April 28 is the 'World Day for Safety and Health at Work'. It was triggered by the trade union movement and officially adopted by the ILO in 2003.
trick: Trap: Do not confuse May 1 (Labour Day) with April 28. The latter specifically targets occupational safety and hazard prevention.
tip: April 28 is the ILO's World Day for Safety and Health at Work.

question: Match the following marine/maritime global days with their organizing bodies: List I: A. World Oceans Day B. World Maritime Day C. Day of the Seafarer. List II: 1. UNGA (Resolution 63/111) 2. International Maritime Organization (Convention entry into force 1958) 3. International Maritime Organization (Manila Amendments 2010). Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World Oceans Day (June 8) was officially recognized by the UN General Assembly in 2008 (A-1). Step 2: World Maritime Day (Last Thursday of Sept) celebrates the 1958 entry into force of the IMO Convention (B-2). Step 3: Day of the Seafarer (June 25) was established via the 2010 Manila Amendments to the STCW Convention by the IMO (C-3).
trick: Trap: Oceans Day is environmental (UNGA/UNEP). Maritime and Seafarer Days are operational/shipping (IMO).
tip: Oceans Day: UNGA. Maritime Day: IMO 1958. Seafarer Day: IMO Manila Amendments.

question: Consider the following statements regarding the 'International Day of the Girl Child': I. It is observed on October 11. II. It began as a project by the non-governmental organization Plan International. III. The Beijing Declaration (1995) was the first international blueprint to explicitly call out girl child rights. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: The UN declared October 11 as the International Day of the Girl Child. Statement I is true. Step 2: It evolved from the 'Because I Am a Girl' campaign by Plan International. Statement II is true. Step 3: The 1995 World Conference on Women in Beijing produced the Beijing Declaration, historically the first to specifically articulate the rights of girls. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Do not confuse International Girl Child Day (Oct 11, Plan International/UN) with National Girl Child Day (Jan 24, Indira Gandhi's oath).
tip: International Girl Child Day (Oct 11) stemmed from Plan International's campaign.

question: Which global day, observed on August 19, commemorates the 2003 Canal Hotel bombing in Baghdad that killed 22 UN staff members?
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date and the event: August 19, Baghdad bombing (2003). Step 2: The bombing devastated the UN headquarters in Iraq, killing Sergio Vieira de Mello. Step 3: To honor those who risk their lives to provide assistance, the UNGA designated August 19 as World Humanitarian Day.
trick: Trap: It sounds like a memorial day, but the official UN designation is 'World Humanitarian Day' to honor all aid workers globally.
tip: World Humanitarian Day (Aug 19) marks the 2003 UN Canal Hotel bombing in Baghdad.

question: Regarding the 'International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women' (November 25), what historical event triggered this date?
options: The adoption of the CEDAW convention in 1979.
The assassination of the Mirabal sisters in the Dominican Republic in 1960.
The Beijing World Conference on Women in 1995.
The formation of UN Women in 2010.
answer: The assassination of the Mirabal sisters in the Dominican Republic in 1960.
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: November 25. Step 2: Women's rights activists have observed this day since 1981. Step 3: It honors the Mirabal sisters, three political activists who were brutally assassinated on Nov 25, 1960, by order of Dominican dictator Rafael Trujillo. The UNGA officially adopted the day in 1999.
trick: Trap: CEDAW is the legal convention, but the specific date (Nov 25) honors the historical martyrdom of the Mirabal sisters.
tip: Nov 25 (Elimination of Violence against Women) honors the assassinated Mirabal sisters.

question: Match the following Health/Medical awareness days with their founders or origins: List I: A. World Polio Day B. World Malaria Day C. World Autism Awareness Day. List II: 1. Adopted by the UNGA in 2007 upon Qatar's proposal 2. Established by Rotary International 3. Established by the WHO World Health Assembly in 2007. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World Polio Day (Oct 24) was established by Rotary International to commemorate Jonas Salk's birthday (A-2). Step 2: World Malaria Day (April 25) was established by the World Health Assembly in 2007 (B-3). Step 3: World Autism Awareness Day (April 2) was designated by a 2007 UNGA resolution proposed by Qatar (C-1).
trick: Trap: Polio Day wasn't created by the WHO directly; it was spearheaded by Rotary International, a major partner in the Global Polio Eradication Initiative.
tip: Polio Day: Rotary. Malaria Day: WHO Assembly. Autism Day: UNGA (Qatar proposal).

question: Consider the following regarding 'World Cities Day': I. It is observed on October 31. II. It concludes the 'Urban October' month launched by UN-Habitat. III. It was established following the 2010 Shanghai World Expo. Which of the statements is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Cities Day is celebrated globally on October 31. Statement I is true. Step 2: It serves as the capstone event for UN-Habitat's 'Urban October'. Statement II is true. Step 3: It was proposed in the Shanghai Declaration at the 2010 World Expo and officially adopted by the UNGA in 2013. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: October 31 is National Unity Day in India, but globally it is World Cities Day, heavily driven by UN-Habitat.
tip: World Cities Day (Oct 31) concludes UN-Habitat's Urban October.

question: The 'International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples' is observed on August 9. What specific milestone does this date mark?
options: The adoption of the UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP) in 2007.
The signing of the ILO Indigenous and Tribal Peoples Convention in 1989.
The first meeting of the UN Working Group on Indigenous Populations in Geneva in 1982.
The establishment of the UN Permanent Forum on Indigenous Issues in 2000.
answer: The first meeting of the UN Working Group on Indigenous Populations in Geneva in 1982.
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: August 9. Step 2: While UNDRIP is the major legal framework (adopted in Sept 2007), the specific date of August 9 was chosen for a different reason. Step 3: It marks the day of the very first meeting, in 1982, of the UN Working Group on Indigenous Populations in Geneva.
trick: Trap: The UNDRIP is the most famous document, but the date anchors to the pioneering 1982 Working Group meeting.
tip: August 9 marks the first 1982 meeting of the UN Working Group on Indigenous Populations.

question: Which day is observed by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) on the 4th Thursday of April every year to empower women in STEM fields?
options: International Day of Women and Girls in Science
explanation: Step 1: Identify the organizing body: ITU. Step 2: Identify the demographic and theme: Women in STEM/Tech. Step 3: The ITU established 'International Girls in ICT Day', observed on the 4th Thursday of April, to encourage girls and young women to consider careers in Information and Communication Technologies.
trick: Trap: 'Women and Girls in Science' is a UN-wide day on Feb 11. The ITU-specific floating observance in April is exclusively 'Girls in ICT Day'.
tip: The ITU observes Girls in ICT Day on the 4th Thursday of April.

question: Match the following Disarmament and Peace observances with their dates: List I: A. International Day of Peace B. International Day against Nuclear Tests C. International Day of Non-Violence. List II: 1. August 29 2. September 21 3. October 2. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: International Day of Peace (UNGA declared) is September 21 (A-2). Step 2: International Day against Nuclear Tests is August 29, marking the closure of the Semipalatinsk test site in Kazakhstan in 1991 (B-1). Step 3: International Day of Non-Violence is October 2, Gandhi's birthday (C-3).
trick: Trap: Nuclear test day isn't Hiroshima day (Aug 6). It is Aug 29, honoring Kazakhstan shutting down the Soviet test site.
tip: Peace Day: Sept 21. Anti-Nuclear Tests: Aug 29 (Kazakhstan). Non-Violence: Oct 2.

question: Regarding the 'World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought' (June 17), which specific international document does it commemorate?
options: The United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)
answer: The United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)
explanation: Step 1: Identify the focus: Desertification. Step 2: The major Rio conventions are UNFCCC, CBD, and UNCCD. Step 3: June 17 was declared by the UNGA in 1995 to acknowledge the day the UNCCD was adopted in Paris in 1994.
trick: Trap: Ramsar deals with the opposite (wetlands). UNCCD is uniquely tasked with drylands and desertification.
tip: June 17 marks the 1994 adoption of the UNCCD (Desertification).

question: Consider the 'International Day of Rural Women'. I. It is observed on October 15. II. It was established by the UNGA in 2007. III. It recognizes the role of rural women in enhancing agricultural development and food security. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: International Day of Rural Women is observed globally on October 15 (a day before World Food Day). Statement I is true. Step 2: It was officially established by the UNGA via a resolution in 2007. Statement II is true. Step 3: The core mandate is acknowledging rural women's critical contribution to agriculture and food security. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: It falls precisely between World Standards Day (Oct 14) and World Food Day (Oct 16), creating a thematic synergy with agriculture.
tip: Rural Women's Day (Oct 15) immediately precedes World Food Day (Oct 16).

question: The 'World Tsunami Awareness Day' was established to be observed on November 5. Which historical event primarily influenced the proposal for this specific date?
options: The 2004 Boxing Day Tsunami in Indonesia.
The story of 'Inamura-no-hi' saving a Japanese village in 1854.
The massive 1960 Valdivia earthquake and tsunami in Chile.
The establishment of the INCOIS early warning system in India.
answer: The story of 'Inamura-no-hi' saving a Japanese village in 1854.
explanation: Step 1: In 2015, the UNGA designated November 5 as World Tsunami Awareness Day. Step 2: The day was proposed by Japan. Step 3: The specific date honors a Japanese anecdote 'Inamura-no-hi' (the burning of rice sheaves). On Nov 5, 1854, a village leader set fire to his harvested rice to warn villagers of an incoming tsunami, saving their lives.
trick: Trap: The 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami is more famous globally, but the UN date honors an ancient, successful Japanese disaster risk reduction strategy.
tip: World Tsunami Awareness Day (Nov 5) honors an 1854 Japanese early warning anecdote.

question: Match the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural observances with their target dates: List I: A. International Literacy Day B. World Teachers' Day C. World Science Day for Peace and Development. List II: 1. October 5 2. September 8 3. November 10. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: International Literacy Day, established by UNESCO, is observed on September 8 (A-2). Step 2: World Teachers' Day is observed on October 5, marking the 1966 ILO/UNESCO recommendation concerning the status of teachers (B-1). Step 3: World Science Day for Peace and Development is observed on November 10 (C-3).
trick: Trap: India's Teachers' Day is Sept 5. World Teachers' Day is exactly one month later, on October 5.
tip: India Teachers' Day: Sept 5. World Teachers' Day: Oct 5. Literacy: Sept 8.

question: Consider the 'World Toilet Day'. I. It is an official United Nations international observance day. II. It is celebrated on November 19. III. It aims to tackle the global sanitation crisis and achieve SDG 6. Which of the statements is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: Though originally created by the World Toilet Organization in 2001, it was officially recognized as a UN day in 2013. Statement I is true. Step 2: It is observed annually on November 19. Statement II is true. Step 3: The core objective directly aligns with UN Sustainable Development Goal 6 (water and sanitation for all by 2030). Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: It sounds like a non-governmental novelty day, but it is a highly serious, official UN observance tied to SDG 6.
tip: World Toilet Day (Nov 19) is an official UN day targeting SDG 6 (Sanitation).

question: Which international day, observed on December 18, was established to commemorate the 1990 adoption of the International Convention on the Protection of the Rights of All Migrant Workers and Members of Their Families?
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: December 18. Step 2: Identify the convention: Rights of Migrant Workers (1990). Step 3: In 2000, the UNGA proclaimed December 18 as International Migrants Day, distinguishing economic and labor migrants from refugees (who flee persecution).
trick: Trap: Distinguish between Refugees (June 20, 1951 Convention) and Migrants (Dec 18, 1990 Convention).
tip: International Migrants Day (Dec 18) marks the 1990 Convention on Migrant Workers.

question: Regarding the 'International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking', consider the following: I. It is observed on June 26. II. It commemorates Lin Zexu's dismantling of the opium trade in Guangdong, China, in 1839. III. It was instituted by the UNGA in 1987. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: The UN observes this day on June 26. Statement I is true. Step 2: The date specifically commemorates the historical event where Lin Zexu destroyed 1.2 million kg of opium in Humen, triggering the First Opium War, a key event in drug control history. Statement II is true. Step 3: The UNGA officially adopted this day in 1987. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Believing UN days only mark modern treaties. This day honors a 19th-century historical milestone in the fight against narcotics.
tip: Anti-Drug Day (June 26) commemorates the 1839 destruction of opium in China.

question: Match the following modern media and communication days with their dates: List I: A. World Television Day B. World Press Freedom Day C. World Telecommunication Day. List II: 1. May 17 2. November 21 3. May 3. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: World Television Day is Nov 21, marking the date the first World Television Forum was held at the UN in 1996 (A-2). Step 2: World Press Freedom Day is May 3 (Windhoek Declaration) (B-3). Step 3: World Telecommunication Day is May 17 (ITU founding) (C-1).
trick: Trap: Television day is not about the invention of TV, but rather the 1996 UN Television Forum recognizing TV's impact on decision-making.
tip: Television: Nov 21. Press Freedom: May 3. Telecommunication: May 17.

question: Which of the following days is observed on May 22 to commemorate the adoption of the text of the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) by the Nairobi Final Act in 1992?
explanation: Step 1: Identify the treaty: Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD). Step 2: The UN originally designated Dec 29 to mark its entry into force, but shifted it in 2000. Step 3: The date was changed to May 22 to commemorate the adoption of the text of the Convention at the Nairobi conference in 1992.
trick: Trap: Biological Diversity Day used to be Dec 29, but it clashed with holidays, so the UN permanently moved it to May 22 (the text adoption date).
tip: Biological Diversity Day (May 22) marks the 1992 adoption of the CBD text.

question: Consider the 'World Day of Social Justice'. I. It is observed on February 20. II. It was established by the UN General Assembly in 2007. III. The 2008 ILO Declaration on Social Justice for a Fair Globalization is a core foundation of its observance. Which of the statements is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: The UN declared February 20 as World Day of Social Justice. Statement I is true. Step 2: It was adopted via a UNGA resolution in 2007. Statement II is true. Step 3: The ILO's unanimous adoption of the Declaration on Social Justice for a Fair Globalization in 2008 acts as the guiding doctrine for the day's events. Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: Social Justice is a broad term, but internationally, it is heavily tethered to ILO labor rights, fair globalization, and Decent Work principles.
tip: World Day of Social Justice (Feb 20) aligns heavily with ILO labor rights doctrines.

question: Which specific global treaty protocol is celebrated every year on 'World Ozone Day' (September 16)?
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: September 16. Step 2: While the Vienna Convention was the overarching framework, the actionable treaty that phased out CFCs was the Montreal Protocol. Step 3: World Ozone Day specifically marks the exact date the Montreal Protocol was opened for signature in 1987.
trick: Trap: The Vienna Convention was earlier (1985), and Kigali is the newest amendment (2016), but Sept 16 explicitly marks the 1987 Montreal Protocol.
tip: World Ozone Day (Sept 16) specifically marks the 1987 Montreal Protocol.

question: Match the UN Decades with their official timelines: List I: A. UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration B. UN Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development C. UN Decade of Action on Nutrition. List II: 1. 2016-2025 2. 2021-2030 3. 2021-2030. Select the correct combination:
explanation: Step 1: The UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration runs from 2021 to 2030 (A-2). Step 2: The UN Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development also runs concurrently from 2021 to 2030 (B-3). Step 3: The UN Decade of Action on Nutrition (led by FAO and WHO) runs from 2016 to 2025 (C-1).
trick: Trap: 2021-2030 is a massive multi-decade overlap period for the UN, hosting both Ecosystem Restoration and Ocean Science decades simultaneously to meet the SDGs.
tip: Both Ecosystem Restoration and Ocean Science are UN Decades from 2021 to 2030.

question: The 'International Day of Democracy' was established by the UNGA in 2007 to be observed on September 15. This date corresponds to the adoption of the Universal Declaration on Democracy by which organization?
explanation: Step 1: Identify the date: September 15. Step 2: The UNGA established this day to promote democratic principles. Step 3: The date marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration on Democracy in 1997 by the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU), a global organization of national parliaments.
trick: Trap: Assuming all UN days mark UN treaties. Democracy Day marks a declaration by the IPU, which works closely with the UN but is a separate entity.
tip: Democracy Day (Sept 15) marks the 1997 IPU Universal Declaration on Democracy.

question: Consider the following statements regarding the 'World Day against Child Labour': I. It is observed on June 12. II. It was launched by the International Labour Organization (ILO) in 2002. III. It seeks to ratify and promote ILO Convention No. 138 and Convention No. 182. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Day against Child Labour is universally observed on June 12. Statement I is true. Step 2: The ILO initiated it in 2002 to highlight the plight of child laborers. Statement II is true. Step 3: The legal backbone of this observance revolves around driving global ratification of ILO Conventions 138 (Minimum Age) and 182 (Worst Forms). Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: None. The question systematically breaks down the exact legal (Conventions 138/182) and institutional (ILO 2002) roots of the day.
tip: Anti-Child Labour Day (June 12) drives ratification of ILO Conventions 138 and 182.

question: Which day is observed on October 9 to mark the anniversary of the establishment of the Universal Postal Union (UPU) in 1874?
explanation: Step 1: Identify the organization: Universal Postal Union (UPU). Step 2: It was established by the Treaty of Bern in Switzerland in 1874. Step 3: To honor this historic milestone in global communication, the 1969 UPU Congress in Tokyo declared October 9 as World Post Day.
trick: Trap: UPU is a UN specialized agency today, but its founding in 1874 makes it the second oldest international organization worldwide (after the ITU).
tip: World Post Day (Oct 9) marks the 1874 founding of the Universal Postal Union.

question: Regarding 'International Mother Earth Day', consider the following: I. It is observed on April 22. II. The UN officially renamed it from 'Earth Day' to 'International Mother Earth Day' in 2009. III. It commemorates the signing of the Paris Climate Agreement in 2015. Which is/are INCORRECT?
explanation: Step 1: Earth Day has been observed on April 22 since 1970. Statement I is correct. Step 2: The UNGA officially adopted a resolution in 2009 to formally designate it 'International Mother Earth Day'. Statement II is correct. Step 3: While the Paris Agreement was deliberately opened for signature on Earth Day in 2016 (not 2015), the day itself predates the agreement by decades. Statement III is incorrect.
trick: Trap: The Paris Agreement was opened for signature ON Earth Day to capitalize on the momentum, but Earth Day was not created to commemorate the Paris Agreement.
tip: Earth Day (April 22) was formally renamed Mother Earth Day by the UN in 2009.

question: Match the following historical milestones with their corresponding UN Observance Days: List I: A. 1948 founding of the World Health Organization B. 1945 founding of the Food and Agriculture Organization C. 1961 first human spaceflight. List II: 1. April 12 2. April 7 3. October 16. Select the correct code:
explanation: Step 1: The WHO was founded on April 7, 1948 (World Health Day) (A-2). Step 2: The FAO was founded on October 16, 1945 (World Food Day) (B-3). Step 3: Yuri Gagarin made the first human spaceflight on April 12, 1961 (International Day of Human Space Flight) (C-1).
trick: Trap: Health Day and Space Flight Day are very close in April. Health is April 7; Space is April 12.
tip: Health Day: April 7. Space Flight Day: April 12. Food Day: Oct 16.

question: The 'International Day of Co-operatives' is unique because its date is not fixed to a specific calendar date. When is it observed?
explanation: Step 1: Many UN days float rather than having fixed dates. World Habitat Day is the first Monday of October. World Maritime Day is the last Thursday of September. Step 2: The International Day of Co-operatives, recognized by the UN and the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA), is officially celebrated on the first Saturday of July.
trick: Trap: Confusing floating days. First Monday of October = Habitat Day. Last Thursday of Sept = Maritime Day. First Saturday of July = Co-operatives Day.
tip: International Day of Co-operatives floats, landing on the first Saturday of July.

question: Consider the 'World Standards Day'. I. It is observed on October 14. II. It honors the efforts of organizations like IEC, ISO, and ITU. III. It marks the date in 1946 when delegates gathered in London to create an international organization for standardization. Which are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Standards Day is globally observed on October 14. Statement I is true. Step 2: It specifically honors the collaborative work of the major standards bodies: IEC, ISO, and ITU. Statement II is true. Step 3: The date commemorates the historic 1946 London meeting of delegates from 25 countries who decided to form an international organization to facilitate standardization (leading to ISO). Statement III is true.
trick: Trap: ISO is the most famous, but the day officially honors the triad of standardization: ISO (General), IEC (Electrical), and ITU (Telecommunications).
tip: World Standards Day (Oct 14) marks the 1946 London meeting that led to ISO.

question: Consider the following statements regarding World Ozone Day: 1. It is observed globally on September 16. 2. It commemorates the adoption of the Kyoto Protocol in 1987. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Ozone Day is observed on September 16 every year. Step 2: The day officially commemorates the signing of the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer in 1987. Step 3: It has no relation to the Kyoto Protocol, making statement 2 incorrect.
trick: Trap: Environmental protocols are easily swapped. The Kyoto Protocol (1997) targets greenhouse gases, whereas the Montreal Protocol (1987) targets ozone depletion.
tip: World Ozone Day (Sept 16) marks the Montreal Protocol.

question: Match List I (International Day) with List II (Historical Inception Trigger): List I: A. World Health Day, B. World Food Day, C. World Post Day. List II: 1. Founding of UPU in 1874, 2. Founding of WHO in 1948, 3. Founding of FAO in 1945.
explanation: Step 1: World Health Day (April 7) commemorates the foundation of the World Health Organization in 1948. Step 2: World Food Day (October 16) marks the creation of the Food and Agriculture Organization in 1945. Step 3: World Post Day (October 9) celebrates the establishment of the Universal Postal Union in 1874. Step 4: Therefore, A-2, B-3, C-1 is correct.
trick: Trap: 'World Post Day' is an outlier because the UPU is one of the oldest international organizations (1874), predating the UN.
tip: Health: WHO (1948), Food: FAO (1945), Post: UPU (1874).

question: Regarding World Wetlands Day observed on February 2, which landmark environmental treaty does it commemorate?
explanation: Step 1: World Wetlands Day raises global awareness about the vital role of wetlands. Step 2: It is celebrated on February 2 to mark the date of the adoption of the Convention on Wetlands. Step 3: This treaty was signed in 1971 in the Iranian city of Ramsar.
trick: Trap: Do not confuse the Bonn Convention (migratory species) with the Ramsar Convention (wetlands).
tip: World Wetlands Day (Feb 2) commemorates the 1971 Ramsar Convention.

question: Consider the following regarding Human Rights Day: 1. It is observed annually on December 10. 2. It marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) by the UN General Assembly in 1948. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: Human Rights Day is observed globally on December 10. Step 2: The date honors the UN General Assembly's adoption of the UDHR. Step 3: This landmark adoption occurred in 1948, creating the foundation for modern international human rights law.
trick: Trap: Some candidates confuse the establishment of the UN (Oct 24, 1945) with the UDHR adoption (Dec 10, 1948).
tip: Human Rights Day (Dec 10) marks the 1948 UDHR adoption.

question: What historical milestone in 1987 triggered the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to establish World Population Day on July 11?
options: The global population reaching one billion
The global population reaching five billion
The signing of the International Conference on Population and Development
The publication of the 'Limits to Growth' report
answer: The global population reaching five billion
explanation: Step 1: World Population Day was established by the Governing Council of the UNDP in 1989. Step 2: It was inspired by the public interest in 'Five Billion Day'. Step 3: Five Billion Day was observed on July 11, 1987, when the world's population reached that approximate threshold.
trick: Trap: The 'Limits to Growth' was a 1972 report. The specific trigger for the July 11 observance was the five-billion milestone.
tip: World Population Day (July 11) was inspired by 'Five Billion Day' in 1987.

question: Match List I (UN Day) with List II (Convention/Declaration): List I: A. World Environment Day, B. International Day for Biological Diversity, C. World Press Freedom Day. List II: 1. Windhoek Declaration (1991), 2. Stockholm Conference (1972), 3. Nairobi Final Act (1992).
explanation: Step 1: World Environment Day (June 5) marks the 1972 Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment. Step 2: Biodiversity Day (May 22) marks the adoption of the CBD agreed in the Nairobi Final Act (1992). Step 3: Press Freedom Day (May 3) marks the 1991 Windhoek Declaration. Step 4: Correct match is A-2, B-3, C-1.
trick: Trap: May 22 (Biodiversity) specifically links to the Nairobi Final Act, not the Rio Summit itself where it was opened for signature.
tip: Environment: Stockholm. Biodiversity: Nairobi Act. Press Freedom: Windhoek.

question: Regarding World Meteorological Day, consider the following statements: 1. It is observed on March 23. 2. It commemorates the coming into force of the convention establishing the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) in 1950. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Meteorological Day takes place annually on March 23. Step 2: It commemorates the date in 1950 when the WMO Convention came into force. Step 3: The WMO subsequently became the specialized agency of the UN for meteorology.
trick: Trap: WMO replaced the older International Meteorological Organization (IMO) established in 1873, but the 1950 convention triggers the specific date.
tip: World Meteorological Day (March 23) marks the 1950 WMO Convention.

question: International Civil Aviation Day is observed on December 7. It historically commemorates the signing of which landmark document?
explanation: Step 1: December 7 is recognized globally as International Civil Aviation Day. Step 2: It was established to highlight the importance of international civil aviation. Step 3: It specifically marks the signing of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (also known as the Chicago Convention) in 1944.
trick: Trap: The Warsaw Convention deals with international carriage liability. The core foundation of ICAO was the 1944 Chicago Convention.
tip: Civil Aviation Day (Dec 7) commemorates the 1944 Chicago Convention.

question: Consider the following statements about World Intellectual Property Day: 1. It is celebrated on April 26. 2. It marks the day the WIPO Convention entered into force in 1970. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Intellectual Property Day is observed globally on April 26. Step 2: The date was selected by member states of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO). Step 3: It coincides with the date on which the convention establishing WIPO entered into force in 1970.
trick: Trap: WIPO administers many treaties (like Paris or Berne conventions), but the day explicitly marks the establishment of WIPO itself.
tip: World IP Day (April 26) marks the 1970 WIPO Convention.

question: Which specialized UN agency's foundation in 1865 is commemorated every year on May 17 as World Telecommunication and Information Society Day?
explanation: Step 1: May 17 marks the anniversary of the signing of the first International Telegraph Convention. Step 2: This convention led to the creation of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) in Paris in 1865. Step 3: It is now celebrated as World Telecommunication and Information Society Day.
trick: Trap: ITU is actually the oldest specialized agency of the UN, established in 1865, well before the UN existed.
tip: World Telecom Day (May 17) marks the ITU's founding in 1865.

question: Match List I (Wildlife/Nature Day) with List II (Treaty/Event): List I: A. World Wildlife Day, B. World Day to Combat Desertification, C. International Day of Forests. List II: 1. CITES Signature (1973), 2. UNCCD Draft (1994), 3. UNGA Resolution (2012).
explanation: Step 1: World Wildlife Day (March 3) commemorates the 1973 signing of CITES. Step 2: World Day to Combat Desertification (June 17) marks the 1994 drafting of the UNCCD. Step 3: International Day of Forests (March 21) was established purely by a 2012 UNGA resolution without a specific older treaty.
trick: Trap: CITES handles wildlife trade, tying directly to World Wildlife Day, making A-1 a strong anchor.
tip: Wildlife: CITES. Desertification: UNCCD. Forests: UNGA 2012.

question: Regarding the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women (November 25), what historical event triggered this observance?
options: The adoption of the CEDAW convention by the UN
The assassination of the Mirabal sisters in the Dominican Republic
The inaugural World Conference on Women in Mexico City
answer: The assassination of the Mirabal sisters in the Dominican Republic
explanation: Step 1: November 25 is observed as the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. Step 2: The date was chosen by women's rights activists in 1981 to commemorate the brutal assassination of the three Mirabal sisters in 1960. Step 3: The sisters were political activists in the Dominican Republic.
trick: Trap: CEDAW (adopted in 1979) is the landmark legal treaty, but the date November 25 specifically honors the Mirabal sisters.
tip: Nov 25 marks the assassination of the Mirabal sisters (1960).

question: Consider the following statements about World Tourism Day: 1. It is observed annually on September 27. 2. It commemorates the adoption of the UNWTO Statutes in 1970. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Tourism Day is celebrated each year on September 27. Step 2: The date marks the anniversary of the adoption of the Statutes of the organization in 1970. Step 3: This paved the way for the establishment of the United Nations World Tourism Organization (UNWTO).
trick: Trap: Do not confuse UNWTO (Tourism, based in Madrid) with WTO (Trade, based in Geneva). The September 27 date is strictly UNWTO.
tip: World Tourism Day (Sept 27) marks the 1970 UNWTO Statutes.

question: Which of the following days is observed on June 20 to commemorate the approval of the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees?
explanation: Step 1: The 1951 Refugee Convention is the foundational legal document outlining the rights of the displaced. Step 2: To draw attention to their plight, the UN General Assembly established World Refugee Day. Step 3: It is observed globally on June 20.
trick: Trap: International Migrants Day is December 18. World Refugee Day strictly focuses on displaced persons under the 1951 convention on June 20.
tip: World Refugee Day (June 20) links to the 1951 Refugee Convention.

question: Match List I (Health Awareness Day) with List II (Historical Origin/Discovery): List I: A. World Tuberculosis Day, B. World Blood Donor Day, C. World Malaria Day. List II: 1. Karl Landsteiner's birthday, 2. Robert Koch's bacterial discovery, 3. Roll Back Malaria Partnership launch.
explanation: Step 1: World TB Day (March 24) marks Dr. Robert Koch's 1882 discovery of the TB bacillus. Step 2: World Blood Donor Day (June 14) marks the birthday of Karl Landsteiner, who discovered blood groups. Step 3: World Malaria Day (April 25) evolved from Africa Malaria Day, driven by the Roll Back Malaria partnership. Correct match: A-2, B-1, C-3.
trick: Trap: 'TB Day' isn't tied to a UN resolution primarily, but to a massive scientific milestone in 1882 by Robert Koch.
tip: TB Day: Koch's discovery. Blood Donor: Landsteiner's birthday.

question: Consider the following regarding the International Day of UN Peacekeepers: 1. It is observed on May 29. 2. It marks the establishment of the first UN peacekeeping mission (UNTSO) in 1948. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: The UN General Assembly designated May 29 as the International Day of UN Peacekeepers. Step 2: This specific date commemorates the day in 1948 when the UN Truce Supervision Organization (UNTSO) was established. Step 3: UNTSO, deployed in the Middle East, was the UN's first peacekeeping mission.
trick: Trap: Do not assume peacekeeping started with the UN's inception in 1945. The first mission (UNTSO) was formed three years later in 1948.
tip: Peacekeepers Day (May 29) marks the first mission, UNTSO (1948).

question: Which specialized UN agency's declaration, adopted in 2008, serves as the foundational trigger for the World Day of Social Justice observed on February 20?
explanation: Step 1: The World Day of Social Justice is observed on February 20. Step 2: It is heavily championed by the International Labour Organization (ILO). Step 3: The day promotes the 2008 ILO Declaration on Social Justice for a Fair Globalization.
trick: Trap: Social Justice encompasses broad concepts, making UNESCO a tempting guess, but it is deeply anchored in ILO's fair labor frameworks.
tip: World Day of Social Justice (Feb 20) is championed by the ILO.

question: Consider the following statements regarding World Radio Day: 1. It is observed annually on February 13. 2. It marks the anniversary of the creation of United Nations Radio in 1946. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: Proclaimed by UNESCO in 2011, World Radio Day is observed on February 13. Step 2: The date was proposed by the Director-General of UNESCO because it marks the anniversary of the creation of United Nations Radio in 1946. Both statements are accurate.
trick: Trap: India observes its own National Broadcasting Day on July 23. World Radio Day is February 13 based on the UN Radio inception.
tip: World Radio Day (Feb 13) marks the 1946 creation of UN Radio.

question: Which of the following dates was adopted by the UN General Assembly to observe 'Nelson Mandela International Day', marking the anti-apartheid leader's birthday?
explanation: Step 1: The UN officially declared Nelson Mandela International Day in 2009. Step 2: The day is celebrated annually on July 18. Step 3: It corresponds directly to Nelson Mandela's birthday, honoring his 67 years of public service.
trick: Trap: October 2 is Gandhi's birthday (International Day of Non-Violence). Mandela Day is strictly July 18.
tip: Nelson Mandela International Day is observed on his birthday, July 18.

question: Match List I (Labor & Rights Day) with List II (Triggering Body/Event): List I: A. World Day Against Child Labour, B. World Day for Safety and Health at Work, C. International Day for the Eradication of Poverty. List II: 1. Father Joseph Wresinski's call (1987), 2. ILO Launch (2002), 3. ILO Launch (2003).
explanation: Step 1: World Day Against Child Labour (June 12) was launched by the ILO in 2002. Step 2: World Day for Safety and Health at Work (April 28) was launched by the ILO in 2003. Step 3: Eradication of Poverty Day (Oct 17) traces back to Father Joseph Wresinski's 1987 gathering in Paris. A-2, B-3, C-1.
trick: Trap: Both Child Labour and Safety at Work are ILO creations. Remember Child Labour (2002) came before Workplace Safety (2003).
tip: Child Labour (2002) and Safety at Work (2003) are ILO initiatives.

question: Consider the following statements regarding World Water Day: 1. It is observed annually on March 22. 2. It was formally proposed during the 1992 UN Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED) in Rio de Janeiro. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Water Day is held annually on March 22 to advocate for the sustainable management of freshwater resources. Step 2: The idea was officially proposed in Agenda 21 of the 1992 UNCED (Earth Summit) in Rio de Janeiro. Step 3: Both statements correctly identify the date and its origin.
trick: Trap: The Rio Earth Summit of 1992 triggered multiple days, including World Water Day (March 22) and World Oceans Day (June 8).
tip: World Water Day (March 22) was proposed at the 1992 Rio Earth Summit.

question: What is the historical significance behind the UN designating December 5 as World Soil Day?
options: It marks the founding of the International Union of Soil Sciences
It corresponds with the official birthday of H.M. King Bhumibol Adulyadej of Thailand
It commemorates the signing of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification
It is the anniversary of the first global soil map publication
answer: It corresponds with the official birthday of H.M. King Bhumibol Adulyadej of Thailand
explanation: Step 1: The FAO Conference unanimously endorsed World Soil Day in 2013. Step 2: December 5 was chosen because it corresponds with the official birthday of King Bhumibol Adulyadej of Thailand. Step 3: The King was one of the main proponents of this initiative.
trick: Trap: Environmental days usually link to treaties, but World Soil Day uniquely honors the Thai King for his advocacy in soil preservation.
tip: World Soil Day (Dec 5) honors the birthday of the King of Thailand.

question: Regarding the International Day of Cooperatives, consider the following: 1. It is celebrated on the first Saturday of July. 2. It commemorates the founding of the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA) in 1895. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: The UN officially observes the International Day of Cooperatives on the first Saturday of July every year. Step 2: This timing specifically aligns with the centenary of the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA), established in London in 1895. Both statements are accurate.
trick: Trap: Unlike many UN days with fixed dates, this is a floating observance (First Saturday of July) tied to an 1895 milestone.
tip: Cooperatives Day (1st Saturday of July) marks the 1895 founding of the ICA.

question: Which of the following days is observed on October 31 to promote the international community's interest in global urbanization, inspired by the 'Shanghai Manual'?
explanation: Step 1: World Cities Day was established by the UN General Assembly in 2013. Step 2: It is observed on October 31. Step 3: It evolved from the legacy of the Shanghai Expo 2010 and the 'Shanghai Manual' aimed at sustainable urban development.
trick: Trap: World Habitat Day occurs on the first Monday of October. World Cities Day is a fixed date, October 31.
tip: World Cities Day is October 31, closing out 'Urban October'.

question: Match List I (Awareness Day) with List II (Date): List I: A. World Tsunami Awareness Day, B. International Day of Education, C. International Day of Women and Girls in Science. List II: 1. January 24, 2. February 11, 3. November 5.
explanation: Step 1: World Tsunami Awareness Day is Nov 5 (inspired by the Japanese 'Inamura-no-hi' anecdote). Step 2: International Day of Education is Jan 24 (UNGA 2018). Step 3: International Day of Women and Girls in Science is Feb 11. Correct match is A-3, B-1, C-2.
trick: Trap: Jan 24 is National Girl Child Day in India, but globally it is recognized as the International Day of Education.
tip: Tsunami: Nov 5. Education: Jan 24. Women/Girls in Science: Feb 11.

question: Consider the following statements regarding World Toilet Day: 1. It is an official UN international day observed on November 19. 2. It was originally established by the World Toilet Organization (WTO) in 2001. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: World Toilet Day tackles the global sanitation crisis and is observed on November 19. Step 2: It was founded in 2001 by Jack Sim, the creator of the World Toilet Organization (a global NGO). Step 3: The UN officially recognized it in 2013. Both are correct.
trick: Trap: WTO usually stands for World Trade Organization. In sanitation diplomacy, it refers to the World Toilet Organization founded in 2001.
tip: World Toilet Day (Nov 19) was initiated by the World Toilet Organization in 2001.

question: Which of the following UN observances was triggered by a 2014 UN General Assembly resolution introduced by India and co-sponsored by a record 177 member states?
explanation: Step 1: The proposal for an International Day of Yoga was first introduced by the Indian Prime Minister during his 2014 UNGA address. Step 2: The resolution was adopted in record time with 177 co-sponsors. Step 3: It established June 21 as the International Day of Yoga.
trick: Trap: International Day of Non-Violence (Oct 2) was also pushed by India, but that was in 2007. Yoga was the record-breaking 2014 resolution.
tip: International Day of Yoga (June 21) was established by a 2014 UNGA resolution.

question: Consider the following regarding the International Day of Epidemic Preparedness: 1. It is observed on December 27. 2. It was proclaimed by the UN in 2020 directly in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Which is correct?
explanation: Step 1: To highlight the need for resilient healthcare systems, the UN declared December 27 as the International Day of Epidemic Preparedness. Step 2: The resolution was adopted in December 2020 as a direct, urgent response to the devastation caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Both are correct.
trick: Trap: Do not confuse this with World Health Day (April 7). This day was explicitly formulated due to the 2020 COVID-19 fallout.
tip: Epidemic Preparedness Day (Dec 27) was established in 2020 due to COVID-19.

question: Match List I (Floating UN Day) with List II (Schedule): List I: A. World Habitat Day, B. World Philosophy Day, C. International Day of Cooperatives. List II: 1. First Saturday of July, 2. First Monday of October, 3. Third Thursday of November.
explanation: Step 1: World Habitat Day is observed on the first Monday of October. Step 2: World Philosophy Day (introduced by UNESCO) is the third Thursday of November. Step 3: International Day of Cooperatives is the first Saturday of July. A-2, B-3, C-1.
trick: Trap: Floating days are harder to memorize than fixed dates. Habitat kicks off 'Urban October' on the very first Monday.
tip: Habitat: 1st Monday Oct. Philosophy: 3rd Thursday Nov. Cooperatives: 1st Saturday July.

question: The 'International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer' is another name for which of the following?
explanation: Step 1: The formal UN designation is 'International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer'. Step 2: In common parlance and competitive exams, it is universally referred to as World Ozone Day. Step 3: It is observed on September 16, marking the Montreal Protocol.
trick: Trap: The UN uses long, formal names. Do not mistake it for World Environment Day (June 5) which is a broad ecological umbrella.
tip: International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer is World Ozone Day.

question: Consider the following statements regarding World AIDS Day: 1. It was the first-ever global health day, designated in 1988. 2. It is observed annually on December 1. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Step 1: World AIDS Day was established by the WHO in 1988 to unite people in the fight against HIV. Step 2: It holds the distinction of being the first-ever global health day. Step 3: It is consistently observed on December 1. Both statements are accurate.
trick: Trap: People might assume World Health Day (April 7) was the first 'global health day', but World AIDS Day (1988) was the first condition-specific global health day.
tip: World AIDS Day (Dec 1) was the first global health awareness day (1988).

question: Which historical document, adopted in 1991 to promote an independent and pluralistic African press, serves as the foundation for World Press Freedom Day (May 3)?
explanation: Step 1: In 1991, African journalists produced a landmark document for press freedom in Windhoek, Namibia. Step 2: To commemorate the Windhoek Declaration, the UN General Assembly proclaimed May 3 as World Press Freedom Day in 1993.
